# European Air Quality Index (EEA, 2025 revision)

Code `eu_eaqi` · version 2025 (WHO 2021-aligned bands) · scale: levels 1–6 · method: step

## Sources

- [ETC HE Report 2024/17, EEA's revision of the European air quality index bands (3 July 2025), Table 5.2 'Final agreed updated EEA European air quality index' and Table 6.1 health messages](https://www.eionet.europa.eu/etcs/etc-he/products/etc-he-products/etc-he-reports/etc-he-report-2024-17-eeas-revision-of-the-european-air-quality-index-bands), accessed 2026-10-21

## Categories

| Level | Category | Colour | Health message |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Good | `#50F0E6` | The air quality is good. Enjoy your usual outdoor activities. *Sensitive groups:* The air quality is good. Enjoy your usual outdoor activities. |
| 2 | Fair | `#50CCAA` | Enjoy your usual outdoor activities. *Sensitive groups:* Enjoy your usual outdoor activities. |
| 3 | Moderate | `#F0E641` | Enjoy your usual outdoor activities. *Sensitive groups:* Consider reducing intense outdoor activities if you experience symptoms. |
| 4 | Poor | `#FF5050` | Consider reducing intense outdoor activities if you experience symptoms such as sore eyes, a cough or a sore throat. *Sensitive groups:* Consider reducing physical activities, particularly outdoors, especially if you experience symptoms. |
| 5 | Very poor | `#960032` | Consider reducing intense outdoor activities if you experience symptoms such as sore eyes, a cough or a sore throat. *Sensitive groups:* Reduce physical activities, particularly outdoors, especially if you experience symptoms. |
| 6 | Extremely poor | `#7D2181` | Reduce physical activities outdoors. *Sensitive groups:* Avoid physical activities outdoors. |

## Breakpoints

| Pollutant | Averaging | Unit | Good | Fair | Moderate | Poor | Very poor | Extremely poor |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| PM2.5 | 1h | µg/m³ | 0–5 | 6–15 | 16–50 | 51–90 | 91–140 | > 140 |
| PM10 | 1h | µg/m³ | 0–15 | 16–45 | 46–120 | 121–195 | 196–270 | > 270 |
| O₃ | 1h | µg/m³ | 0–60 | 61–100 | 101–120 | 121–160 | 161–180 | > 180 |
| NO₂ | 1h | µg/m³ | 0–10 | 11–25 | 26–60 | 61–100 | 101–150 | > 150 |
| SO₂ | 1h | µg/m³ | 0–20 | 21–40 | 41–125 | 126–190 | 191–275 | > 275 |

## Rules

- Each pollutant's hourly mean is rounded half-up to an integer and classified with inclusive upper bounds. The 2025 revision uses hourly PM; the old index used a running 24-h mean.
- The index is the worst sub-index across available pollutants.

## Implementation notes and source discrepancies

- The index is computed from whatever subset of pollutants is available. Results without PM are flagged 'partial' in the API. EEA's map has its own station-inclusion rules, which we do not replicate.
- Open-Meteo's 'european_aqi' field uses its own continuous 0-100+ mapping of the older bands, so it is not comparable with this table. AirAtlas always recomputes from concentrations.
- This is the AirAtlas common comparison scale.
